summary.text: Little Immortal Xing Luo is a female Gu Immortal Fang Yuan seeks out in treasure yellow heaven while researching star path killer moves.

claims.text: Over divine sense she answers to her name and offers negotiable prices. Her goods are few and common. Prior life memory places her as a lone cultivator at the hard start of trading, large among mortals yet ordinary among Gu Immortals there, and newly advanced with weak foundations. That same memory has her shine in the five regions war with self-created icy stardust, gathering wealth from battle and becoming a famous figure later on.

She sells the ice path killer move icy yarn for half an immortal essence stone, the lowest price she names for a rank five killer move. She also holds her own star path small killer move six-nine stardust, built from six rank three Gu and nine rank four Gu to reach rank five attack power. After tribulation she is left without immortal essence stones and plans shiver trees in a blessed land suited to them, but she lacks startup immortal funds. Fang Yuan buys icy yarn together with six-nine stardust for that half stone.
A later tally of his treasure yellow heaven spending lists both killer moves among the purchases.

Fang Yuan later judges that without icy yarn and six-nine stardust he could not have deduced icy drill stardust even with wisdom Gu. He reads those two moves as the foundation of the icy stardust killer move she will create, and he bought the earlier forms intending to rebuild that line. When she begins to rise she is still extremely poor.
When Fang Yuan sorts people for connect luck, he ignores her too: her luck is poor and she would reach only small scale fame.

Central Continent’s Little Immortal Xing Luo bargains over immortal materials in treasure yellow heaven, then loses the deal to a richer buyer. She is a lone immortal with only rank six cultivation and cannot match that buyer’s wealth.
